verdict.rationale: Docs confirm developers can send custom events, fields, session data, and historical backfills via REST/Events API, and scores incorporate this business-specific data rather than just network defaults (sift-docs-2, sift-docs-4, sift-docs-10, sift-docs-11). Community evidence corroborates real-world custom integration of events (sift-comm-2, sift-comm-6). missing for 10: independent verification of device fingerprinting specifically, and quantified evidence of how custom metadata measurably changes scoring outcomes.
